method: Built-in image_gen tool, one generation per asset; original PNG files copied without editing.

prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square terrain texture for a small hexagonal tile on a fantasy simulation globe. Strict orthographic straight-down overhead view, no horizon, no perspective tilt. Painterly hand-painted strategy-game terrain, readable large forms, restrained natural colors, softly lit with no directional shadows, no dramatic lighting. Entire square filled edge-to-edge with terrain; no hexagon outline, no borders, no labels, no text, no watermark. Detail must remain readable when reduced to a tiny game tile. Subject: a dense unbroken green forest canopy, clusters of rounded tree tops and occasional dark gaps. Leafy emerald and moss green crowns at varied sizes. No visible trunks, buildings, roads, people or sky.
